name: Saikyou no Furyou ga Nyotaika! Tsundere Ore Kuchou no Bishoujo ni!? ~Baka! Naka ni Dasu Yatsu ga Aru ka, Ore ga Ninshin Nante Arienee!~
original_name: 最強の不良が女体化！ツンデレ俺口調の美少女に!? ～馬鹿！中に出す奴があるかっ、俺が妊娠なんて有り得ねえ！～

Subaru was the hardest of a gang of thugs, directly descended from martial artists.
